wing_name: Anonymiser Used Around a File-Sharing Upload (Behaviour)
description: Within one hour, one person visits an anonymising service (a web proxy, Tor gateway or VPN site in UBA's site categories) and submits a form to a file-sharing site, in either order. UBA rules: browser_visit_anonymiser and browser_upload_inferred. Both come from the person's own browser history, so the person is the profile owner.
proves: A person used an anonymising service around an upload to a file-sharing site
author: Crow-Eye Team

steps.label: Form submitted to a file-sharing site
